what: Hovering the photo cell makes the first photo ripple sideways and slide out along a noise distortion map, while the second photo ripples in from the opposite side and settles in 1.6s expo.out. On release it reverses in 1.2s (WebGL, distortion strength .3). On touch devices it switches on each tap
use: (If an element has data-label instead of img, it draws the label on a skin-colored placeholder panel)
note: Images are cropped to fill the cell (cover). Images from a different origin cannot be uploaded to WebGL, so use images from the same domain

from.where: about.html .rc-today__pic — original hover-effect (three r108 + TweenMax): intensity .3, speedIn 1.6, speedOut 1.2, Expo.easeOut, one distortion image (we use noise)
